name: Expanded Favored Weapon [Psionic]
body:
Your mastery of weapons is broader than most.

Prerequisites: Favored weapon class feature, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: Choose one additional weapon group. You gain all the normal benefits of your favored weapon class feature this weapon group in addition to your original weapon group.
